intermediate.name: Alto de Santo Domingo
intermediate.title: KOM Sprint (3) Alto de Santo Domingo (2.35 km)

story: Roglič set an early strong time, but Paul Seixas went significantly faster. Thanks to the uphill final kilometre, no one could match his effort. Seixas secured victory, finishing ahead of Kévin Vauquelin and Felix Großschartner.
